trends.name: US-Iran Ceasefire Fragility & Strait of Hormuz Control
trends.summary: Iran accuses US of breaching ceasefire, triggering oil price volatility and geopolitical uncertainty. Control over Strait of Hormuz and potential Iranian toll collection on tankers poses systemic risk to global energy markets. Polymarket pricing 85% probability of diplomatic meeting by April 30, but escalation risks remain high with Trump's strategic posture creating NATO friction.

trends.name: Stagflation Signals in US Services Sector
trends.summary: ISM Services PMI dropped to 54.0 (miss of 54.9) in March with employment index collapsing -6.6 points to 45.2, weakest since December 2023. Combined with rising recession odds reflected in Treasury gains, markets are pricing in stagflation risk—weak growth with persistent inflation pressures that challenge equity valuations.

trends.name: Central Bank Gold Accumulation Accelerates
trends.summary: Global central banks purchased 19 tonnes of gold in February, marking 23rd consecutive monthly purchase with year-to-date total at 25 tonnes. Poland led with 20 tonnes, signaling coordinated de-dollarization and hedge against geopolitical instability. This structural demand floor supports gold prices amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Trump's NATO Rift & Greenland/Troop Redeployment
trends.summary: Trump publicly targets Greenland as 'poorly run' and signals plan to redeploy troops from NATO members to non-NATO countries, deepening alliance fractures. US strategy deemed unhelpful to Iran war effort, destabilizing European defense posture and creating uncertainty for defense contractors and NATO-aligned economies.

trends.name: AI Model Competition & OpenAI IPO Momentum
trends.summary: Meta launches new AI model to compete with Google and OpenAI after massive capex spend. OpenAI advances IPO preparations with retail investor allocation announced by CFO, signaling major capital raises in AI infrastructure race. Institutional positioning ahead of potential OpenAI debut will reshape tech sector flows.

trends.name: Commercial Real Estate Crisis: CMBS Delinquencies Spike
trends.summary: CMBS delinquencies surge to Covid-era highs unexpectedly, signaling commercial real estate distress across office, retail, and hospitality segments. With rising rates and weak occupancy, defaults could cascade through financial system, impacting bank earnings and credit spreads.

trends.name: Beer & Spirits Demand Shift: Consumer Trade-Down
trends.summary: Constellation Brands withdraws 2028 guidance citing consumer weakness and shifting preferences toward cheaper beer/wine. Corona brewer reports shoppers trading down, signaling broader consumer discretionary pressure and demand normalization post-inflation. Impacts Conagra and packaged food peers.

trends.name: Treasury Yield Volatility & Rate Repricing
trends.summary: Treasuries rally on recession odds while rate volatility ('Rates Spark') creates repricing in fixed income and equities. Asian currency consolidation reflects fragile risk sentiment tied to macro uncertainty. Equity valuations remain hostage to rate expectations amid recession signals.

trends.name: India Garment Exports Under Tariff & War Pressure
trends.summary: $100 billion Indian garments export goal threatened by escalating Iran conflict and potential US tariff escalation. Supply chain disruptions and trade policy uncertainty create headwinds for India's largest export sector, impacting Asian supply chains and inflation dynamics.

trends.name: Prediction Markets Surge & Retail Investor Engagement
trends.summary: Kalshi prediction market surges to 91% share of US prediction market volume, with Polymarket and Crypto.com showing massive growth. Retail participation in policy outcome betting reflects elevated macro uncertainty and investor demand for directional hedges on geopolitical/political events.

trends.name: Defense Tech Upside & Aerospace Manufacturing Challenges
trends.summary: Exail Technologies growth story viewed as 'far from over' amid geopolitical escalation, but Archer Aviation highlights manufacturing challenges as production ramps. Defense sector benefits from spending, but supply chain constraints and execution risks weigh on valuations.

trends.name: Healthcare Crisis: Medicare Advantage Cancer Coverage Gaps
trends.summary: Major hospitals refusing Medicare Advantage coverage for cancer patients, creating systemic access crisis. Regulatory/policy scrutiny on insurer profitability and benefit design could drive reform, impacting UnitedHealth, Anthem, and insurance sector margins.
